normalization_plan.reason: Deposit amount parameter belongs to deposit(); merge into that core entry function
Deadline is only consumed by the common validation helper
Slippage bound is enforced by _validateCommon and swap helpers
Withdraw share amount parameter belongs to withdraw()
User supplied token price is consumed by the token->ETH swap helper
User supplied FARM price is consumed by the token->ETH swap helper
User supplied ETH price is consumed by the ETH->token swap helper
Storage pointer to the caller's UserInfo is created in withdraw()/deposit()
Receipt token balance is read only inside withdraw()
WithdrawData struct accumulates withdraw-specific intermediate values
Reward amount is produced by _calculateRewards and consumed by withdraw()
Swap path array is built in withdraw() and passed to the swap helpers
Fee token amount is derived from _calculateFee
fToken amount is the return value of the vault deposit helper
